_: The house component registry. One entry per shared surface. `make components` renders the `Shared components` section of DESIGN.md from the entries whose section is `Shared components`; `bin/design-registry check` verifies every `implements` and `proof` path still exists. Add a component before you build a new surface: bin/design-registry add --name ... --purpose ... --spec ... --implements repo:path

components.name: Launcher panel
components.purpose: The floating command surface: type, see ranked rows, act with a key.
spec: `input` row 58 high with a leading search glyph and one 28 px square menu
section labels in `section`
rows 40 high with a tile, `label` title, `meta` detail, and either key caps or a `meta` type label on the right
footer 40 high painted as a `well`, status dot + context on the left, primary key and ⌘K on the right

components.name: Composer
components.purpose: The shared chat entry pattern: attach, write, act, and open commands.
spec: a pill-shaped field on a quiet stroke, beginning at `Control.pill` height and growing within a bounded line limit before scrolling
a leading plus circle and trailing command circle at `Control.pill`, using the same glyph, stroke, hover and focus roles
a real primary-action button inside the field; Return sends, Shift-Return inserts a line, `⇧⌘A` attaches, and `⌘K` opens searchable actions
attachment readiness and failures remain visible above the field; floating choices fit in the remaining space and keyboard selection scrolls into view
`@` and `+` open searchable context choices; `/new` clears draft and pending sources without deleting saved history or ending a recording

the context choices name how far the search reaches, so source-only versus broader retrieval stays reachable before Send; the effective image destination remains visible above the field; completed answers expose their model and used context
empty Return keeps the app's explicitly labelled delivery or quick action; IME composition and active choices take precedence

components.name: Hidden launcher items
components.purpose: Review and restore results hidden from discovery without deleting their sources.
spec: Settings Items has a searchable Hidden view using the existing settings table and type filters
each row names the item and kind, marks unavailable sources, and offers Restore; Restore All is explicit
Hide from Quick Launch is distinct from Hide Windows; hidden items keep aliases, pins and hotkeys
components.mockup: Native behaviour proof: quick-launch/Tests/LauncherHiddenItemsTests.swift; no external mockup on record

components.name: Chat context record
components.purpose: Inspect what a retained answer used and whether its attachments can be reopened.
spec: a compact answer detail exposes effective model, provider destination, reasoning, used sources and phase timings
attachment rows distinguish retained, partial and unavailable content; refresh creates a new source version
history actions distinguish new chat, removal of pending context and confirmed deletion of saved records

components.name: Settings shell
components.purpose: The rail-and-panes window every app uses for its preferences.
spec: 220 px rail on `surfaceSunken` with 36 px rows, the selected row a raised tile
pane title in `title` with a `meta` subtitle
groups as cards at `Radius.lg` with an uppercase `section` label and 40 px rows
ink toggles
footer well with the hint on the left and the primary key on the right

components.name: Pill
components.purpose: The floating recording, processing, and completion feedback for Local Dictation.
spec: compact height is `Control.pill - Spacing.xxs` (32), standard height is `Control.pill` (36), with radius equal to half the height and the shared panel glass
a danger recording dot becomes a cancel glyph on hover inside a stable hit target; Escape and click cancel before insertion begins, without activating the pill
the ink waveform rests near-flat in silence and responds to microphone levels; sensitivity is adjustable without changing recorded audio
optional live transcript text uses the existing sentence-based transcription stream; processing shows Transcribing, Cleaning up when used, and Pasting at insertion, without artificial stage delays
processing details, size, live preview, waveform response, and completion feedback are exposed in Settings; Reduce Motion disables decorative movement
success, copied recovery, held text, and errors state their outcome with words and the existing status tokens

components.name: Chips
components.purpose: A small stateful token in a row: a mode, a filter, a recording clock.
spec: 28 high at `Radius.sm`, `chipFill`, `meta` text
recording is the only chroma, a `danger` dot + clock

components.name: Menu bar panel
components.purpose: A glass panel in place of an NSMenu, hung off the status item.
spec: a 300 px glass panel in place of an NSMenu
header of a 26 px icon tile, app name in `label`, a status line in `caption` with a 6 px dot, and an ink toggle for the one master switch
`divider`
action rows 36 high with a glyph, `label` text, and outlined key caps, selection = `selectionFill` + `selectionRing`
rows may carry two lines (a `label` id over `meta` detail) with a 26 px icon tile, as Local Models' model rows do
a second group for rarer actions
footer well 36 high, Settings ⌘, on the left, Quit ⌘Q on the right
arrows, Return, and Escape drive it, and it closes on focus loss

components.name: Terminal
components.purpose: The text form of the house rule: status line, uppercase sections, two-column rows.
spec: monochrome, no ANSI colour except the status dot, and honour `NO_COLOR` and a non-TTY
uppercase section labels, `TODAY`, `OPEN TASKS`, `STORE`
rows read like launcher rows, a title then secondary detail aligned in two columns
one-line status first, `● Ready · 1,204 frames · 63 MB`
no banners, no boxes, no emoji

components.name: App icon
components.purpose: One flat ink squircle and one white verb glyph, shared by app and status item.
spec: rounded square at the macOS 26 squircle radius, 22.5 % of the tile, tile inset 100 px on a 1024 canvas
one flat fill of the near-black ink and one white glyph at 46 % of the tile, optically centred
no gradients, no shadows, no letters in circles
the menu bar item uses the same glyph family as a template image

components.name: Meter row
components.purpose: One quota window or prepaid balance as a bar, so every metered source reads on the same axis.
spec: 28 high under a two-line provider row, inset to the provider's text column
window name in `meta` on the left in a fixed 96 px column so the bars of every provider line up
a 4 px ink bar on a `tileFill` track at `Radius.xs`; the percent in `label` with monospaced digits on the right
percent used is the one axis: a rate window reports it directly, a balance as spend since its 30-day peak
no colour: a window at its cap says 100 % and the `caption` footnote under the group says when it resets; an unknown draws an empty track, never a zero

components.name: Status item
components.purpose: The one glyph an app shows in the menu bar.
spec: one SF Symbol from the app-icon family, as a template image at `Control.statusGlyph` (15 pt) medium weight, so every house item sits on one baseline at one weight
outline when idle; the `.fill` variant means on (a model warm, a capture running); never filled for decoration
colour only for a state that needs a word too: `danger` for recording or a permission fault, in the tooltip and the panel as well
no title text beside the glyph unless the app is a meter (Usage may show its percent in `bodySmall` monospaced digits)

components.name: Quick AI
components.purpose: The chat surface that opens at 750 × 475 from the launcher and keeps a resized window between uses.
spec: header 58 high with no divider: a `chevron.left` in `glyphSmall` `textSecondary`, the chat title in `subheading` over the model display name in `meta`, and an `arrow.up.right.square` expand glyph in `glyphMedium` on the right

thread: user turns as right-aligned pills on `chipFill` at `Radius.pill` in `bodySmall` `textSecondary`; answers as `body` prose capped at `Layout.quickAIAnswerMaxWidth`, no card; one tool or status line in `bodySmall` `textTertiary`

composer row along the bottom edge, inset `Spacing.xs`: a `Control.pill` plus circle on `surfaceTint`, a field at `Radius.pill` with a `stroke` hairline and no fill, and a matching `command` circle; the field grows from one to four lines, then scrolls; its primary action is a button with `label` text and a key cap; `↩` sends and `⇧↩` inserts a new line; attachment and action panes scroll within the remaining space above the measured composer; no footer well

Recent Chats (`⌘P`) in place of the thread: a `section` label with its key hints, then the launcher-panel chat rows (26 px `IconTile`, `label` title, `meta` question count and time, 40 high) pinned first, selection = `selectionFill` + `selectionRing`; the composer reads Open ↩

components.name: AI Chat window
components.purpose: One conversation window over the same providers and tools as Quick AI, for a chat that needs to stay open beside other work.
spec: a normal titled window with a transparent title bar on the opaque `surface` ground, `Layout.chatWidth` × `Layout.chatHeight`, at least `chatMinWidth` × `chatMinHeight`, its frame kept

header `Control.input` high sharing its row with the traffic lights: a `sidebar.left` glyph in `glyphSmall` `textSecondary`, the Quick AI title block (title in `subheading` over the model in `meta`), and a `square.and.pencil` new-chat glyph in `glyphMedium` on the right
the Quick AI thread and composer as shared subviews; the composer grows to eight lines, `↩` sends and `⇧↩` starts a new line

find bar (`⌘F`) under the header: `Control.pill` high at `Radius.md` on `surfaceTint` with a `stroke` hairline, the count in `meta` `textTertiary`, Next and Previous key hints; the current match drawn with `selectionFill` + `selectionRing`

chat list rail `Layout.chatRail` wide on `surfaceSunken`, hidden until `⌃⌘S`: a `Control.chip` search field at `Radius.sm`, `section` labels Pinned then Recent, two-line rows `Control.row` high (`label` title over `meta` count and time), selection = `selectionFill` + `selectionRing`, `⌘1`…`⌘9` caps on the open and highlighted rows, `⌘K` row actions with a separate fuzzy search on a raised card

the chat list rail begins with the pinned Chief of Staff row (never renamed or deleted, no ⌘ number), its waiting count as `meta` digits on a `chipFill` capsule; opened, a status line carries health as a status dot and words, the project filter chip, and List, Board, Activity, Artifacts and Charter (⌥⌘1 to ⌥⌘5; ⌘1 to ⌘9 stay the rail's), the current one selected with its caps; Activity groups the day under `section` labels with `meta` times, Artifacts lists drafts as 40-high rows with Open and Discuss, Charter shows its sections read only with Add rule and Edit charter and the rungs with Remove; its other keys (⌥↑ Cards, ⌘N New task, ⇧⌘P Project, ⇧⌘↩ Do all Today, ⌘I Health, ⇧⌘T Tasks) as key caps in a strip over the composer; the List (DECIDE, TODAY, WAITING ON OTHERS, PROJECTS rows with a risk dot and words, LATER, FYI) scrolls within 60 % of the conversation over the thread; the Board's columns (Decide, Today, Waiting, Later, Done this week) take the thread's room; ↑ from an empty composer or ⌥↑ moves onto the cards, esc back; the root view forces no minimum width, so any window width reflows

components.name: Selected text preview
components.purpose: Inspect the complete text attached to the next question before sending it.
spec: a Preview button on the selected-text chip, also opened with `⌥⌘I`
a popover with the source app, a complete selectable and scrollable text view in `body`, and a clear next-message status
uses `surface`, `textPrimary`, shared spacing and corner radii; stays readable in both appearances

components.name: Dictation recovery detail
components.purpose: Inspect and recover a captured dictation without replaying actions into the current app.
spec: shows the saved audio with playback and the dictation status, followed by selectable raw and processed text versions
Recover re-transcribes the saved audio with optional cleanup and copies the result to the clipboard; existing versions remain available
audio is local, retained for 30 days by default, with retention and recovery controls in Settings; expired or unavailable audio is stated beside its actions
uses House settings/list surfaces, semantic text and status tokens, and native keyboard-accessible controls in both appearances

components.name: Session browser
components.purpose: Read an archived meeting, replay its audio, and act on its content.
spec: sidebar rows use `Radius.row`; file selectors are compact pills; content sections use `Radius.lg` and a readable column capped at `Layout.rtiAnswerMaxWidth`
Copy, Share, Trash, and playback icon controls are circles with the shared icon-action treatment
audio playback aligns the retained microphone and system legs; the player shows play/pause, seek, time and explicit availability
saved chat content has a clear route to the existing session-grounded House composer; deletion confirms Move to Trash for owned archives
components.mockup: User-supplied session-window references; synthetic RTI SessionsWindowRenderProofTests

components.name: Setup checklist
components.purpose: Get a fresh install from launch to a working dictation, and say which requirement is missing when one is.
spec: a standalone panel on the opaque `surface` ground at `Layout.panelWidth`, with the shared panel chrome
a pane title in `title` over a `meta` subtitle stating what is still needed
one requirement per row, `Control.row` high: a 26 px icon tile, the requirement in `label` over its live state in `meta`, a status dot, and a chip carrying its single action on the right
status is a dot plus a word, never colour alone: `success` when satisfied, `danger` when not
state is re-read about once a second while the window is open, so a grant made in System Settings lands without a relaunch and the row's action drops away
footer well with the hint on the left

components.name: Proposal card
components.purpose: One proposal from the chief of staff, answered with Do it, Edit, Later or No before anything acts; keyboard first in Quick Launch's pinned Chief of Staff conversation.
spec: a DECIDE card: raised on `surfaceRaised` at `Radius.lg` with a `stroke` hairline, the `highlightTop` line, and the `card` shadow; `Spacing.sm` inside
source, the due day as a phrase (by tomorrow, 2 days late) and time in `meta`; the headline in `heading`, why in `bodySmall` `textSecondary`; a card with no headline shows its message in `body`

the message in `body` `textPrimary`; the numbered actions under it: the number in `meta` `textTertiary` in a `Spacing.sm` column, the type label and due date in `caption`, the action text in `bodySmall` `textSecondary`
buttons `Control.chip` high at `Radius.tile`: Do it (Got it when nothing runs) an ink fill with inverse ink, Edit, Later and No outlined like key caps; never accent; they wrap when the card is narrow

Edit turns each action into its own field (a note, a task title and due date, or a reply body) in a `well` at `Radius.sm` with a `strokeStrong` hairline, and the buttons become Run and Cancel; Escape leaves Edit
after a verdict the card shows one line per action: a `success` or `danger` dot, OK or FAIL in `label`, and the detail in `meta`; never colour alone

the card with the keyboard wears a `strokeStrong` hairline and shows its keys as outlined caps beside its buttons: ⌘↩ Do it, ⌘E Edit, ⌘L Later, ⌘⌫ No; ⌘L opens a raised menu of Tonight, Tomorrow 9:00, Next week and Pick date (1 to 4); TODAY cards are 40-high rows (headline in `label`, source, actions and due in `meta`, one Do it); WAITING, LATER and FYI are one-line rows in collapsed sections; the Board shows compact tiles at `Radius.row`

every card carries quiet More and Less glyphs (`caption` `textTertiary`, filled once given, ⌘= ⌘-); an escalated card shows a `warning` dot, Reviewer in `label` and the reason in `meta`; Discuss (⌘D) sits with the buttons; after a Do it the offer "Always do this for <project>?" is a `surfaceTint` strip at `Radius.lg` with Always (⌘Y, ink) and Not now (esc); a card a rung ran reads "I did this" under FYI with Undo (⌘Z); the morning brief is a `surfaceTint` card pinned first in TODAY; a meeting card leads with "Starts in N min", its place and project

`cos tell`: in the pinned conversation a reply that made a card draws that card under it with the keyboard on it; typing or a bare ↩ on a card writes about it, shown as an About chip at `Control.chip` on `chipFill` over the key strip (esc clears); Discuss opens a branch (Continue branch once one exists): a strip over its composer with the branch glyph, "Branch · <headline>" in `meta` and Close branch (⇧⌘W, an outlined button with its caps); a card the branch made joins it after the answer, the reply named "Chief of Staff:"; the merge-back line sits under its card in EARLIER (glyph, text in `meta`, Open branch); branch rows nest under the pinned row in the rail, indented `Spacing.md`, unnumbered

components.name: Live transcript
components.purpose: Read a meeting as it happens: who said what, calm enough to glance at mid-call.
spec: no box or chip per speaker; a run of one speaker carries one label line: a 6 px speaker-palette dot, the name in `meta` medium `textSecondary`, the time in `caption` `textTertiary`

the mic wearer's runs sit on the right as a `chipFill` bubble at `Radius.pill` in `bodySmall` `textPrimary`, inset `Spacing.xxxxl` from the left; everyone else is plain `bodySmall` text on the left capped at `Layout.answerMaxWidth`
speaker labels come from the speaker id and never change mid-meeting (You, Speaker N, Room speaker N); a click names the speaker, offering the confirmed meeting's invitees first
interim words follow the final words in `textTertiary` in the run they belong to, so a final result recolours them in place
a long run breaks into paragraphs `Spacing.sm` apart at sentence ends; a break never moves once made, and interim words join only the open paragraph

runs `Spacing.lg` apart; a note is a glyph label over `textSecondary` text; the list follows the latest line until the user scrolls up, then a `Control.chip` capsule on `surfaceRaised` offers Jump to latest
archived transcripts in the Session browser use the same label line, once per run of one speaker, with the dot colour the live view gave that speaker
